title: vamos.fun
tagline: Permissionless prediction markets for any event — create bets, pick a judge, get trustless payouts.
description: This project is a permissionless prediction market platform that lets anyone create a bet on any real-world or personal event — from sports matches to friendly challenges. Users set the rules, stake funds, and appoint a designated judge who is responsible for confirming the outcome. All actions are transparent and recorded on-chain, ensuring trustless payouts once the judge settles the result. The platform is designed to be simple, social, and accessible, enabling small group bets and community contests without relying on centralized oracles or rigid market templates. It turns everyday predictions into a fair, fun, and verifiable experience.
how_its_made:
Our project is a  Prediction Markets embedded on a Celo Miniapp that relies on CDP to automate prize distribution.
It basically allows anyone to create markets to any given competition, assigning an arbitraty address as judge responsible for determining the outcome.

Key Features:
* Create custom prediction markets for any competition or event
* Designated judge system (judges cannot vote to ensure impartiality)
* Automated prize distribution via CDP integration
* Seamless integration with Celo Miniapp ecosystem to be used on both: MiniPay and Farcaster
